inventory.visualPurpose: Phenylalanine pathway with the PKU block and BH4 loop
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 82 PKU figure: dietary protein/aspartame/endogenous protein → phenylalanine —(phenylalanine hydroxylase, BH4; ⊟ PKU)→ tyrosine → thyroxine/dopamine/melanin/NE-epi; phenylalanine → phenyl ketones; BH4 ↔ BH2 with dihydropteridine reductase (NAD+ / NADH + H+) and the BH4-deficiency block.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: Methionine–homocysteine pathway with homocystinuria's four blocks
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 83 homocystinuria figure: methionine ↔ homocysteine (methionine synthase, methyl B12; methyl folate + B12 feeds in) → cystathionine (cystathionine synthase + serine) → cysteine (B6); the four causes with treatments and the HOMOCYstinuria mnemonic.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 83 organic-acidemia figure: protein metabolism (Valine, Odd-chain fatty acids, Methionine, Isoleucine, Threonine — VOMIT) → propionyl-CoA —(propionyl-CoA carboxylase, biotin)→ methylmalonyl-CoA —(methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, B12)→ succinyl-CoA → TCA cycle intermediates; propionic vs methylmalonic acidemia blocks.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 82 clinical photograph (label A): the eye with bluish-black scleral/ear cartilage pigmentation from homogentisic acid polymer deposition in alkaptonuria — redrawn as an original KYP diagnostic-pattern schematic (the N-batch photo pattern).

notes: All four source figures are full redraws: sv1 the p. 82 phenylalanine pathway (PKU block + BH4 loop), sv2 the p. 83 methionine-homocysteine pathway (four homocystinuria blocks), sv3 the p. 83 propionate highway (VOMIT → succinyl-CoA → TCA), sv4 the p. 82 ochronosis clinical photograph (label A) redrawn as a diagnostic-pattern schematic. MSUD and cystinuria have no source figures on these pages; both are carried by the note's MSUD strip, the six-diseases table, and the cystinuria clinical callout.
